# Asep Bagja

> Product and AI engineer in Tallinn, Estonia. Builds AI features, web apps
> (Elixir/Phoenix LiveView, TypeScript, Python), iOS/macOS apps (SwiftUI), and
> hardware/firmware (ESP32, Nerves, CAD automation) for clients. Writes software
> and music-tech articles in English and Indonesian, and runs Nanas Sound
> (music apps and DIY hardware) and nanas.build (AI-driven CAD and 3D printing).

Hire Asep for freelance or contract work: [Work with me](https://www.asepbagja.com/work).
Machine-readable version of that page: [work.md](https://www.asepbagja.com/work.md).

## Own products

- [nanas.build](https://www.nanas.build): custom CAD and 3D printing service in Tallinn; models generated with FreeCAD and build123d, browser 3D inspection with WebGPU, JSON API for AI agents.
- [Nanas Sound](https://www.nanas.ee): music apps (AirBending, Bolabolabola on the App Store) and DIY music hardware.
